name: @house-hunt/core
//: An internal package: the entry points are TypeScript source, transpiled by whichever app imports them. Nothing here is built or published separately.
//exports: Three entry points, and the split is the point. '.' is types, contracts and pure domain logic and pulls in no supabase-js; './db' is the data layer and does; './analysis' is the vision pass and its PNG decoder, which only the analyse route imports. packages/ui may import the first and never the second — see tools/check-one-client.ts.
